final:
type Shape = Rect(w: int, h: int) | Square(side: int) | Tri(b: int, h: int)

-- Dimensions are non-negative and at most 1_000_000_000, so products cannot overflow.
valid(s: Shape) -> bool =
  match s
    Rect(w:, h:) -> w >= 0 and w <= 1000000000 and h >= 0 and h <= 1000000000
    Square(side:) -> side >= 0 and side <= 1000000000
    Tri(b:, h:) -> b >= 0 and b <= 1000000000 and h >= 0 and h <= 1000000000

-- Area rounded down; a triangle's area is b*h/2.
area(s: Shape) -> int =
  pre valid(s)
  post out >= 0
  ex area(Rect(w: 2, h: 3)) == 6
  ex area(Square(side: 4)) == 16
  ex area(Tri(b: 3, h: 3)) == 4
  match s
    Rect(w:, h:) -> w * h
    Square(side:) -> side * side
    Tri(b:, h:) -> (b * h) // 2
